description: Agent harness mono repo: unified multi-provider LLM API (pi-ai) + agent runtime with tool calling & state management (pi-agent-core) + interactive coding agent CLI (pi-coding-agent) + terminal UI library (pi-tui) + web UI components (pi-web-ui). 46K stars in 9 months. Top contributors: badlogic (libGDX creator) and mitsuhiko (Flask/Rye creator). AGENTS.md for human+agent shared rules. OSS session sharing to HuggingFace.
